faers_pharmacovigilance.methodological_caveat: FAERS spontaneous reports reflect stimulated post-launch reporting (Weber effect) and lack exposure denominators. MedDRA PT 'Off label use' captures schedule/line-of-therapy variations as well as unapproved non-SCLC histologies; treat as an exploratory pharmacovigilance signal, not prevalence.

tarlatamab_key_terms.clinical_implication: Predominantly Grade 1-2 in Cycle 1 D1/D8; consistent with Sept 2026 FDA 6-8h outpatient step-up monitoring + Tocilizumab PRN in extracranial cohorts.
Exploratory signal (ROR 2.5 [95% CI 2.19-2.85] vs Blinatumomab); includes dosing/line variations and off-label neuroendocrine use.
Reflects Boxed-Warning ICANS signal; supports inpatient neuro-monitoring + corticosteroids (and high-dose IV anakinra in steroid-refractory ICANS per ASTCT/NCCN practice).
Early hallmark of step-up T-cell cytokine release; managed via dexamethasone pre-medication & antipyretics.
Characteristic reversible dysgeusia reported in DeLLphi trials; non-dose-limiting.

option1_protocol_dossiers.target_line_of_therapy: 2L+ Metastatic / Locally Advanced MCC progressing on or after 1L anti-PD-(L)1 (avelumab, pembrolizumab, or retifanlimab)
option1_protocol_dossiers.unmet_need_and_soc_gap: 1L PD-(L)1 achieves ~40-56% ORR, but ~50% experience primary or acquired resistance; historical 2L cytotoxic chemotherapy yields ~15-20% transient ORR (median PFS <3 mo; Iyer et al. Cancer Med 2016; Becker et al.). Complements Investigator-Initiated MCC Tarlatamab Trial NCT06814496 and pan-EPNEC basket NCT06788938.
option1_protocol_dossiers.biological_and_kg_rationale: Published MCC IHC cohorts report ~89% surface DLL3 positivity (52% >=50% tumor cells; Xie et al. Mod Pathol 2020; Rand et al. 2024) driven by ATOH1/SOX2/INSM1 neuroendocrine lineage factors in both MCPyV+ and UV-induced MCC.
option1_protocol_dossiers.companion_diagnostic_gate: Standardized Ventana SP347 DLL3 IHC >=1% enrollment gate (with pre-specified stratification at >=50% tumor cells); MCPyV status & ctDNA co-tracked.
option1_protocol_dossiers.dosing_and_crs_icans_protocol: Approved IV Step-Up (C1D1 1 mg -> C1D8 10 mg -> C1D15 10 mg Q2W or investigational DeLLphi-309 20 mg Q3W). Extracranial population eligible for Sept 2026 FDA 6-8h Cycle 1 clinic observation + Tocilizumab PRN.
option1_protocol_dossiers.lead_combination_arm: Hypothesis for Clinical Review: Monotherapy vs Tarlatamab + PD-(L)1 Continuation (Pembrolizumab / Durvalumab, informed by ES-SCLC DeLLphi-305 OS HR 0.42).
option1_protocol_dossiers.p0_p1_assumption_source: Assumed p0=18% from historical 2L post-ICI chemotherapy series (15-22%); target p1=40% benchmarked to DeLLphi-301 2L SCLC ORR.
option1_protocol_dossiers.primary_endpoint: Confirmed Objective Response Rate (ORR) by RECIST v1.1 per BICR + Duration of Response

option1_protocol_dossiers.biological_and_kg_rationale: Parafollicular C-cells are neural-crest neuroendocrine cells expressing ASCL1/INSM1 -> DLL3: clinical MTC IHC demonstrates 89.1% DLL3+ and 35.3% high >=50% expression enriched in desmoplastic/aggressive MTC (Ingenwerth et al.), whereas TCGA papillary thyroid cancer is DLL3-low.
option1_protocol_dossiers.companion_diagnostic_gate: Standardized Ventana SP347 DLL3 IHC >=1% enrollment gate (with pre-specified stratification at >=50% tumor cells) + confirmed MTC histology; serial serum Calcitonin & CEA kinetics as secondary pharmacodynamic endpoints.
option1_protocol_dossiers.dosing_and_crs_icans_protocol: Approved IV Step-Up (C1D1 1 mg -> C1D8 10 mg -> Q2W/Q3W) under Sept 2026 6-8h outpatient rule; evaluate baseline neck/airway tumor bulk and serum calcium/calcitonin prior to C1D1.
option1_protocol_dossiers.lead_combination_arm: Hypothesis for Clinical Review: Tarlatamab Monotherapy (Arm B1) vs exploratory TKI sequencing/combination (non-overlapping target_jaccard = 0.0).
option1_protocol_dossiers.p0_p1_assumption_source: Assumed p0=12% in post-selpercatinib/cabozantinib salvage MTC; target p1=32% clinically meaningful single-agent activity.
option1_protocol_dossiers.primary_endpoint: RECIST v1.1 Confirmed ORR + Secondary Serum Calcitonin/CEA Response Rate

option1_protocol_dossiers.dossier_nature: Illustrative Phase 2 Concept Synopsis (Dedicated Registrational Cohort Complementing NCI ETCTN NCT07788365 & Pan-EPNEC Basket NCT06788938)
option1_protocol_dossiers.target_line_of_therapy: 2L Metastatic Small Cell / High-Grade Neuroendocrine Carcinoma of the Urinary Bladder (SCBC) or Uterine Cervix (SCNEC) post-platinum/etoposide
option1_protocol_dossiers.unmet_need_and_soc_gap: Rare extrapulmonary small-cell carcinomas (median 2L OS 5-8 months; historical salvage chemo ORR ~12-16%, Frumovitz et al. / Siefker-Radtke et al.) with zero competitor dedicated Phase 2/3 DLL3 trials; complements NCI ETCTN Phase 2 GU-NEC tarlatamab study NCT07788365 and pan-EPNEC basket NCT06788938.
option1_protocol_dossiers.biological_and_kg_rationale: Published IHC cohorts show ~68-79% DLL3+ in SCBC (Koshkin et al. Clin Cancer Res 2019) and ~81% DLL3+ in cervical SCNEC, driven by RB1/TP53 loss or HPV18/16 E6/E7 functional RB1/p53 inactivation. Note: public bulk RNA-seq sample sizes in pure SCBC/SCNEC are small (TCGA neuronal BLCA n=7), so IHC gating is essential.
option1_protocol_dossiers.companion_diagnostic_gate: Standardized Ventana SP347 DLL3 IHC >=1% enrollment gate (with pre-specified stratification at >=50% tumor cells); exclude predominant (>50%) non-neuroendocrine urothelial/squamous histology for monotherapy.
option1_protocol_dossiers.dosing_and_crs_icans_protocol: Approved IV Step-Up (1 -> 10 mg) with baseline brain MRI screening (elevated CNS metastasis rate in EPSCC) and 6-8h Cycle 1 observation.
option1_protocol_dossiers.lead_combination_arm: Hypothesis for Clinical Review: Tarlatamab + Anti-PD-(L)1 (Durvalumab / Pembrolizumab) or non-overlapping ADC combination in mixed-histology tumors.
option1_protocol_dossiers.p0_p1_assumption_source: Assumed p0=14% from 2L salvage SCBC/SCNEC retrospective series; target p1=35%.
option1_protocol_dossiers.primary_endpoint: Confirmed ORR (RECIST v1.1) and 6-Month Progression-Free Survival Rate

option1_protocol_dossiers.indication_name: Recurrent Adult IDH1/2-Mutant Grade 3 Astrocytoma & 1p/19q Oligodendroglioma (Post-Vorasidenib)
option1_protocol_dossiers.dossier_nature: Exploratory Phase 1b/2 Translational Concept (High Translational Risk: Post-Vorasidenib DLL3 Retention, BBB Biodistribution, Cold Myeloid TME & ICANS)
option1_protocol_dossiers.target_line_of_therapy: Recurrent Adult WHO Grade 3 IDH1/2-Mutant Astrocytoma or 1p/19q-Codeleted Oligodendroglioma after prior radiation, alkylating chemotherapy (TMZ/PCV), and progression on Vorasidenib (with mandatory post-Vorasidenib DLL3 retention verification)
option1_protocol_dossiers.unmet_need_and_soc_gap: Recurrent high-grade IDH-mutant gliomas progressing after Vorasidenib and alkylating therapy have ~8-10% salvage ORR. Competitive context: 0 Phase 2/3 competitor trials, 1 competitor Phase 1 trial (BI 764532 NCT05916313), and 2 investigator-initiated Tarlatamab CNS studies (NCT06776250, NCT07243470).
option1_protocol_dossiers.biological_and_kg_rationale: IDH1/2 neomorphic 2-HG drives G-CIMP hypermethylation of CTCF insulators (Flavahan et al. Nature 2016), and Spino et al. (Clin Cancer Res 2019) demonstrated selective cell-surface DLL3 expression in IDH-mutant gliomas (~86% IHC+; confirmed here in TCGA LGG/GBM n=425 vs n=151 IDH-WT GBM, 8.0-8.6x mRNA enrichment, p < 1e-31). CRITICAL EPIGENETIC GUARDRAIL: Because mutant-IDH inhibition (Vorasidenib) suppresses 2-HG and can partially reverse G-CIMP promoter/insulator methylation, naive concurrent Vorasidenib + Tarlatamab co-administration risks downregulating surface DLL3; enrollment therefore requires post-Vorasidenib progression with verified DLL3 retention.
option1_protocol_dossiers.companion_diagnostic_gate: Three-step gate: (1) Confirmed adult somatic IDH1 (R132) or IDH2 (R172) mutation (excluding pediatric BRAF/H3K27M IDH-WT gliomas) + (2) Mandatory post-Vorasidenib re-resection Ventana SP347 DLL3 IHC >=25% (or investigational 89Zr-DFO-SC16 DLL3 immuno-PET uptake) confirming target retention after 2-HG inhibition + (3) Contrast-enhancing BBB disruption on MRI.
option1_protocol_dossiers.dosing_and_crs_icans_protocol: CLINICAL DESIGN HYPOTHESIS (Not an approved regimen — requires Clinical Safety & PK review): Exclude from 6-8h outpatient rule; require >=48h inpatient neuro-monitoring with conservative step-up lead-in, corticosteroids first-line for Grade >=2 ICANS/peritumoral edema, and high-dose IV anakinra (100-200 mg IV Q6H-Q12H per ASTCT/NCCN practice to overcome low 0.3%-4% passive CSF penetration) for steroid-refractory ICANS rather than BBB-excluded tocilizumab.
option1_protocol_dossiers.lead_combination_arm: Sequential Post-Vorasidenib Monotherapy Window-of-Opportunity / Phase 1b Lead-In (CSF & surgical-resection PK/T-cell infiltration check); avoid concurrent Vorasidenib unless preclinical/window biopsies confirm maintained surface DLL3 density.
option1_protocol_dossiers.p0_p1_assumption_source: Assumed p0=9% from recurrent high-grade glioma salvage benchmarks (RANO); target p1=28% (85% exact power, alpha=0.05 -> n1=13, N=31).
option1_protocol_dossiers.primary_endpoint: Phase 1b Dose-Limiting CNS/ICANS Rate + Phase 2 RANO 2.0 Confirmed ORR

option1_protocol_dossiers.dossier_nature: Illustrative Phase 1b/2 Combination Concept (Informed by Prospective DeLLpro-300 Readout)
option1_protocol_dossiers.target_line_of_therapy: Metastatic CRPC with biopsy-confirmed de novo or treatment-emergent NEPC post-ARPI and taxane
option1_protocol_dossiers.unmet_need_and_soc_gap: DeLLpro-300 (NCT04702737) observed 22.2% ORR in DLL3+ (>=1% IHC) NEPC vs 0.0% ORR in DLL3- tumors (10.5% unselected), illustrating both proof-of-mechanism and the limitation of monotherapy amidst intrapatient AR+/STEAP1+ luminal + DLL3+ NE heterogeneity (2 competitor Ph2 trials active).
option1_protocol_dossiers.biological_and_kg_rationale: Beltran primary metastatic biopsies (n=49) show 25.1x higher DLL3 mRNA in CRPC-NE vs CRPC-Adeno (p = 9.06e-7), while amphicrine/luminal clones express STEAP1 (Puca et al. Sci Transl Med 2019) — motivating dual-lineage targeting (`target_jaccard = 0.0` once CD3 is excluded).
option1_protocol_dossiers.companion_diagnostic_gate: Mandatory metastatic biopsy Ventana SP347 DLL3 IHC >=1% (stratified at >=50%) + STEAP1 IHC / AR status co-profiling.
option1_protocol_dossiers.dosing_and_crs_icans_protocol: CLINICAL SEQUENCING & T-CELL FITNESS HYPOTHESIS (Requires nonclinical & Phase 1b safety validation): Complete Cycle 1 Tarlatamab step-up (1 -> 10 mg) prior to introducing Xaluritamig (AMG 509) step-up in Cycle 2, transition to intermittent Q3W maintenance with scheduled treatment-free T-cell rest intervals (avoiding continuous dual-CD3 tonic stimulation), and mandate serial peripheral PD-1/TIM-3/LAG-3/TOX T-cell exhaustion immunophenotyping.
option1_protocol_dossiers.lead_combination_arm: Internal Portfolio Hypothesis: Staggered/Intermittent Tarlatamab (AMG 757, DLL3xCD3) + Xaluritamig (AMG 509, STEAP1xCD3) Phase 1b dose-finding (or Enzalutamide backbone in AR-retained amphicrine disease).
option1_protocol_dossiers.p0_p1_assumption_source: Assumed p0=15% salvage chemo / unselected baseline; target p1=38% improving upon DeLLpro-300 22.2% monotherapy DLL3+ ORR.
option1_protocol_dossiers.primary_endpoint: PCWG3 / RECIST v1.1 Confirmed Composite ORR & Radiographic PFS

option1_protocol_dossiers.indication_name: EGFR-Mutant NSCLC Transformed to SCLC (t-SCLC Subset)
option1_protocol_dossiers.dossier_nature: Clinical Subset Extension Concept (Representing ~5-14% Histologic Transformation of Osimertinib-Resistant EGFR+ LUAD, Not a Standalone Organ Ontology Rank)
option1_protocol_dossiers.target_line_of_therapy: Metastatic EGFR-Mutant (Ex19del / L858R) Lung Cancer with Re-Biopsy Confirmed Small-Cell Transformation (t-SCLC) post-Osimertinib
option1_protocol_dossiers.unmet_need_and_soc_gap: 5-14% of osimertinib-resistant EGFR+ LUAD patients transform to t-SCLC (Marcoux et al. JCO 2019); platinum-etoposide yields brief PFS (~3.4 mo) and discontinuing osimertinib risks CNS/systemic flare of residual EGFR+ adenocarcinoma clones.
option1_protocol_dossiers.biological_and_kg_rationale: Quintanal-Villalonga et al. (Clin Cancer Res) reported ~92% DLL3 IHC positivity in transformed EGFR-mutant SCLC, while untransformed lesions remain EGFR-driven. Note: Cohort F is included as a clinical lifecycle subset linked to `EFO_0005288` rather than a separate Top-50 organ ranking node.
option1_protocol_dossiers.companion_diagnostic_gate: Post-osimertinib progression biopsy confirming SCLC morphology + SP347 DLL3 IHC >=1% + founder EGFR mutation.
option1_protocol_dossiers.dosing_and_crs_icans_protocol: Hypothesis for Clinical Review: Continue Osimertinib 80 mg PO + Tarlatamab 1 -> 10 mg IV step-up (6-8h observation; monitor pulmonary/ILD & QTc safety).
option1_protocol_dossiers.lead_combination_arm: Combination Hypothesis: Tarlatamab + Osimertinib Continuation to suppress both DLL3+ t-SCLC and residual EGFR+ LUAD clones.
option1_protocol_dossiers.p0_p1_assumption_source: Assumed p0=20% post-platinum/salvage t-SCLC ORR (Marcoux et al.); target p1=45%.
option1_protocol_dossiers.primary_endpoint: Confirmed Systemic + Intracranial ORR (RECIST v1.1) & Median PFS

option1_protocol_dossiers.biological_and_kg_rationale: Primary pediatric TARGET-NBL tumors (`n=141` RPKM + `n=162` GDC TPM) confirm strong PHOX2B/ASCL1-driven adrenergic DLL3 expression (`MYCN-amp vs non-amp 3.99x, p = 3.34e-8`; `ADRN vs MES p = 0.0096`) and favorable T-effector TME readiness (`0.573`) paired with MHC-I downregulation (`-0.99 log2` vs MES) bypassed by CD3 BiTE cytolysis.
option1_protocol_dossiers.companion_diagnostic_gate: Ventana SP347 DLL3 IHC >=1% + PHOX2B+/Adrenergic lineage confirmation (excluding pure PRRX1+/YAP1+ mesenchymal relapse unless paired with GD2/B7-H3 rescue).
option1_protocol_dossiers.dosing_and_crs_icans_protocol: Body-weight-adjusted pediatric step-up dosing (`0.015 mg/kg` C1D1 -> `0.15 mg/kg` C1D8/D15 Q2W) with mandatory Cycle 1 inpatient pediatric oncology CRS/ICANS monitoring + Tocilizumab/Anakinra readiness.
option1_protocol_dossiers.lead_combination_arm: Pediatric Combination Hypothesis: Tarlatamab + Dinutuximab (anti-GD2) or Irinotecan/Temozolomide (`IT`) chemo-priming.
option1_protocol_dossiers.p0_p1_assumption_source: Assumed p0=15% in post-anti-GD2 chemoimmunotherapy refractory high-risk NBL; target p1=38% clinically transformative pediatric response.
